review:
Big Bass Boxing Bonus Round puts the series in a boxing gym and doubles up on collectors. Gloves, shoes and skipping ropes pay on the base reels, and three, four or five scatters award 15, 20 or 25 free spins, a more generous starting count than most Big Bass games.

During the feature, money symbols worth up to 5,000x can be collected by either a blue or a red wild. Each colour has its own meter: every fourth wild of the same colour levels that meter up, adding 10 more free spins and raising its win multiplier to 2x, then 3x, and finally 10x. Running two progress tracks at once gives the bonus more to watch than a single-trail game. Pragmatic Play doesn't state an overall max win for this title. The RTP is 96.5%.
